description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Quicksilver Gargantuan that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Quicksilver Gargantuan token instead.
